Welcome to my portfolio! I’m a statistician who thrives at the intersection of data and decision-making. Whether I’m developing statistical models, creating interactive dashboards, or exploring new analytical techniques, I’m driven by curiosity and a passion for continuous improvement. This space showcases my journey—from mastering statistical methods to building impactful projects. Take a look around, and I hope you find something that sparks collaboration or inspires a new idea!
